newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Elec to reduce 1997/98 capital outlay--paper.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Elec to reduce 1997/98 capital outlay--paper.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc plans to reduce its 1997/98 capital outlays to 1.45 to 1.50 trillion yen, down more than 50 billion yen from the previous plan announced in March 1996, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday.
A Tokyo Electric Power spokesman said the company had not yet made a decision on its capital investment plans for 1997/98, which would be announced on March 28.
Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the company hopes to cut costs in an effort to lower electricity rates for its customers, which have been criticised as too expensive by international standards.
As part of its cost-cutting efforts, the company plans to increase procurement of equipment from overseas, the paper said.
